messages:
Lena Park: Quick company-wide notice: annual Privacy Attestation plus SOC2/ISO evidence intake is live. Privacy attestation deadline: 2024-04-30. Evidence intake (internal teams): 2024-05-09. Contractors/partners: 2024-05-12. Auditor: Brightline Controls. Portal: https://compliance.internal.redwood/submit (choose 'Annual Intake 2024').

Marcus Li: For DB artifacts, do you want full backups or redacted exports?

Lena Park: We prefer a redacted export that demonstrates retention and deletion workflows + a ticket showing restore test. Do NOT upload production PII. If you must include identifiers, hash them first and note the method in the upload notes.

Olivia Grant: Who gets upload permissions? I can't see the SOC folder in the portal.

Evan Brooks: @Olivia ping @Lena and I'll add your team (platform-eng) to the intake ACL. Also include a short README.txt in the zip explaining what each file is.

Lena Park: Short checklist for teams: 1) IAM role screenshots and list of service principals; 2) Redacted DB export + restore ticket; 3) S3/bucket policy export or equivalent; 4) App config showing auth flows; 5) Evidence of encryption-at-rest (keystore screenshots); 6) Training/attestation screenshot. Use filename prefix: RDW-SOC24_<team>_<artifact>_<YYYYMMDD>_<initials>. Example: RDW-SOC24_platform_IAM_20240415_ML.zip. Full guide + naming rules: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/COMPLIANCE/Annual+Intake+2024

Marcus Li: Noted. We'll include a short script to show the hashing process for IDs.

compliance-bot: Reminder: 10 days until evidence deadline for internal teams (2024-05-09). You have outstanding items: 4. Portal queue: https://compliance.internal.redwood/queue

Lena Park: People Ops note: completion of the privacy course "Data Privacy & You" is required before 2024-04-30. Managers, please ensure direct reports finish the attestation. If you're a contractor, confirm with your vendor liaison. Questions? DM me or open a ticket with tag ANNUAL-COMP-2024.
